messages.subject: Meridian - reviewing C&V's v2
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

The price/retention/longstop changes are all agreed so we accept those. But push back on the 12-month longstop - I'd want at least 12 but ideally keep the de minimis and basket realistic. Can you check their limitation thresholds (clause 14)? I think they left the de minimis at £10k and basket at £35k. For a £14m+ deal I'd lift those to £15k / £50k so we're not chasing trivial warranty claims. Also the overage - Helena wants four years not five.

Draft a v3 with those and I'll review before it goes back.

James

--
